01 / THREE PERSPECTIVES, ONE COMPANY

A reason to participate.
A role in the outcome.

The people taking the risk, coordinating the work, and doing it have different expectations of AI. ANC starts with those needs and connects them through a shared way of working.

01

Owners

“Can I trust it with real work?”

You care about business results and carry the deployment risk. The investment has to make sense in daily operations.

Start with one bounded workflow, an accountable owner, explicit authority, and acceptance criteria. Review the output, delivery evidence, human effort, and exceptions before expanding.

You set the direction, boundaries, and standard for success.

02

Managers

“How do I keep work coordinated and remain accountable?”

You need to know what is progressing, where work is blocked, and which decisions need your judgment.

ANC keeps follow-ups, progress, artifacts, and delivery records connected to the original task. A common record gives you a basis for coordinating people and AI, handling exceptions, and reviewing quality.

You guide priorities, coordination, and exceptions.

03

Employees

“If I share how I work, what happens to my value?”

Fear of replacement affects whether people share their expertise. Catching exceptions, judging quality, and improving a method are valuable contributions.

ANC gives useful knowledge a source and a maintained home. Dojo connects employees to real work and practice in directing AI. We are developing contribution attribution and training cases so improvements can help future work and new colleagues.

Your expertise shapes the methods. Your contribution should remain visible.

Contribution attribution and the complete work-to-training loop are in development. Recognition and incentives must also be designed with the company.

Human on the Loop

At every level, people retain the direction, judgment, and responsibility that belong to their work. AI advances execution within agreed boundaries.

One shared foundation.

Persistent tasks, maintained knowledge, and reviewable results connect these three perspectives in everyday work.

01

Keep work moving.

Follow-ups return to the same task. Progress survives interruptions. When delivery is uncertain, ANC keeps the result and checks before trying again.

CONTINUITY
02

Know what to trust.

Confirmed facts, reusable methods, and current progress have separate homes. Sources and versions make important changes traceable.

COMPANY CONTEXT
03

Make results reviewable.

Define the outcome, owner, boundaries, and acceptance criteria. Preserve evidence of what was produced, delivered, and verified.

ACCOUNTABILITY

Make the whole company work better.

Faster individual work can still run into slow handoffs, waiting, and repeated explanations. ANC also asks how information moves, how capabilities meet, and how results return to the work.

FROM LAWTED’S FIELD NOTES

When every question
goes through the owner.

Lawted traces the ANC framework to work with a racing team. Engineers held tire information, public relations needed sponsor details, and logistics arranged travel. The owner became the relay between them. That experience shaped a direction for ANC: connect company information and working methods so the team can draw on them directly.

THE HARNESS DESIGN

Bring the right capability
into the same workflow.

We design the harness to connect context, capabilities, authority, and results. An agent can carry routine execution forward; judgment, relationships, and action on site call for the right person. The aim is to bring that person’s result back into the continuing task, with responsibility kept clear.
